memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Irritable bowel syndrome.
Patient reports intermittent abdominal pain, bloating, and alternating diarrhoea and constipation for 6 months, worsened after meals. Examination shows mild tenderness in lower abdomen, no masses, normal bowel sounds. Smoking status: never smoker.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Mebeverine 135 mg BD; Ispaghula husk 5 g OD; Loperamide 2 mg SOS.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: CBC: Hb 13.8 g/dL (13-17), WBC 6.2 x10^9/L (4-10), Plt 210 x10^9/L (150-400). Stool routine: no ova, cysts, or occult blood. tTG-IgA: negative (<4 U/mL).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been having more bloating after eating spicy food and my pain scores are up to 5/10 most days.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Irritable bowel syndrome.
Patient notes increased bloating after spicy meals and abdominal pain averaging 5/10. Examination reveals mild distal colonic tenderness, no guarding. Smoking status: never smoker.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Mebeverine increased to 135 mg TID; Ispaghula husk 5 g OD; Loperamide 2 mg SOS.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2025-10-15 at 10:00 with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05

Irritable bowel syndrome.
Patient reports improved bloating after dose change, pain 3/10, occasional constipation. Examination: soft abdomen, no tenderness. Smoking status: never smoker.

memories.author: lab

memories.text:
Irritable bowel syndrome.
Patient describes occasional constipation, uses loperamide SOS, pain 2/10. Examination: benign abdomen. Smoking status: never smoker.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Mebeverine 135 mg BD; Ispaghula husk 5 g OD; Loperamide 2 mg SOS.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Feeling much better, only mild discomfort after heavy meals, no need for loperamide lately.

memories.text:
Irritable bowel syndrome.
Patient stable, reports no flare‑ups in past 3 months, maintains fibre and mebeverine. Examination: non‑tender. Smoking status: never smoker.
